result.stdout:
Usage: batch-produce|b [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Produce batch messages to a Kafka topic from a given file with a specified format

Options:
  -t, --topic <string>             Kafka topic to produce [Required]
  -p, --message-path <string>      Path to a file containing the message payload [Required]
  -f, --message-format <string>    Read from a file per line, and use this format to produce a batch message. Replace file content with #DATA# [Required]
  -b, --batch-size <int>           Batch size of messages to produce in a single batch [Default: 50]
  --kafka-url <string?>            Kafka connection URL. Default: from environment variable KAFKA_URL
  --registry-url <string?>         Schema Registry URL, required when a message or message path is specified. Default: from environment variable SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL.
  -k, --key-format <string?>       Message key
  --header <string[]>...           Message headers in 'Key:Value' format (can be specified multiple times). It also accepts special values like $uuid and $guid in Value (which are basically the same thing).

result.stdout:
Usage: init|i [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Initialize Kafka topics and register schemas

Options:
  --kafka-url <string?>          Kafka connection URL. Default: from environment variable KAFKA_URL
  --registry-url <string?>       Schema Registry URL. Default: from environment variable SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL
  -c, --config-path <string?>    Path to a Kafka topics configuration file. Default: from environment variable KAFKA_TOPIC_FILE.
  -d, --schema-dir <string?>     Directory containing schema files. Default: from environment variable KAFKA_SCHEMA_FOLDER.
  -p, --partition <int>          Default number of partitions per topic when not specified in config [Default: 3]
  -r, --replication <short>      Default replication factor when not specified in config [Default: 1]
